title: BaseCamp：自动化DNA测序数据流程的智能体AI框架
summary: BaseCamp是一个智能体AI框架，将DNA测序流程的决策层分解为六个专业AI智能体，负责样本质控、比对、变异检测、注释、跨阶段监控和报告。智能体不执行序列分析，而是选择配置工具并解读输出，由领域微调LLM联盟在本地运行，保持可复现性与人类监督。
summary_en: BaseCamp is an agentic AI framework that decomposes the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines into six specialized AI agents covering sample intake, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Agents do not perform sequence analysis; they select and configure established tools and interpret outputs, powered by a consortium of fine-tuned domain LLMs running locally under human-in-the-loop orchestration.
